SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q8. Which one of the following rights is guaranteed by the ‘Consumer Protection Act, 1986’?  
(A) Right to Equality  

(B) Right to Choose  
(C) Right to Freedom  
(D) Right to Exploitation

Answer / Solution:
Which one of the following rights is guaranteed by the ‘Consumer Protection Act, 
1986’? 
(B) Right to Choose 
Reasoning: The COPRA 1986 guarantees rights like Right to Safety, Right to 
be Informed, Right to Choose, etc.
